declaration.preface: Shilpa Medicare Limited recognizes that pharmaceutical manufacturing at scale carries significant labor and human rights responsibilities spanning employee health and safety across complex chemical and biological processes, fair and lawful working conditions for a multi-site workforce of over 4,000 people, meaningful social dialogue, continuous career development, and the absolute prevention of exploitation in any form. We are committed to conducting our operations in a manner that fully respects the rights and dignity of every person working within our facilities, our supply chain, and our broader value chain.
declaration.declaration:
Ensure full compliance with all applicable labor laws, regulations, and statutory requirements in India and all international jurisdictions where the Company operates, including the Factories Act 1948, Minimum Wages Act, Payment of Wages Act, Contract Labour Act, Employees' Provident Funds Act, Maternity Benefit Act, POSH Act 2013, and all relevant state-level enactments.

Provide every worker across SML's operations with a safe, healthy, and dignified workplace that protects their physical and mental well-being.

Establish and maintain fair, transparent, and lawful working conditions including accurate and timely wage payments, full statutory benefit coverage, lawful working hours, and written employment contracts for all categories of workers.

Foster genuine social dialogue through structured worker communication forums, effective grievance mechanisms, and a culture of open, non-retaliatory communication between management and employees at all levels.

Invest meaningfully in the career growth, technical capability, and professional development of all employees from shop floor operators to senior scientists.

Maintain absolute zero tolerance for child labour, forced labour, bonded labour, debt bondage, and human trafficking across all SML operations and its extended supply chain and contractor network.

Achieve and sustain a workplace free from discrimination, harassment, bullying, intimidation, and any conduct that undermines human dignity, with rigorous enforcement of the POSH Act 2013.

Integrate human rights due diligence into procurement, supplier qualification, and contractor management processes, extending SML's labor and human rights standards across its value chain.
declaration.scope:
Our commitment extends to all employees permanent and contractual as well as apprentices, trainees, migrant workers, and third-party personnel operating at our API manufacturing units, formulation plants, biologicals facilities, R&D centers, and corporate offices across India and internationally.

This Policy applies to all operations of Shilpa Medicare Limited and its group entities, subsidiaries, and joint ventures, including API manufacturing facilities, formulation plants, R&D centres, CDMO operations, biologics units, analytical laboratories, and corporate and administrative offices. The Policy also extends to all global sales offices located in Malaysia, Austria, Dubai (UAE), the United Kingdom, Spain, and the United States of America. It is applicable to all employees (permanent and contract), management, directors, business associates, vendors, contractors, and all internal and external stakeholders working on behalf of the Company.

focusAreas: Ethical Labor Practices & Human Rights Protection

Occupational Health, Safety & Wellbeing: Management of occupational risks including chemical exposure, HPAPI handling, ergonomic hazards, machinery safety, emergency preparedness, and employee wellness across all manufacturing and laboratory environments.

We will maintain a comprehensive Occupational Health and Safety Management System (OHSMS) aligned with ISO 45001 across all manufacturing plants, API synthesis units, formulation facilities, biologicals operations, and R&D centers, covering process safety, chemical hazard control, ergonomics, PPE management, and emergency preparedness.

We will conduct structured, documented Hazard Identification and Risk Assessments (HIRA) for every job function and work area with particular focus on cytotoxic and HPAPI handling, solvent exposure, high-pressure reactor operations, and biologicals containment.

All employees and contract workers engaged in production, QC, maintenance, and logistics operations will be provided with function-specific, properly fitted, and regularly inspected Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
We will ensure regular health check-ups and medical surveillance of employees and contractor workers by conducting periodic medical examinations based on risk exposure.

We will ensure comprehensive safety training for all employees and contractor workers by conducting mandatory induction training prior to site entry, role-specific safety training for high-risk operations, and periodic refresher sessions, while maintaining training records and evaluating effectiveness through assessments and on-site observations.

We will maintain fully operational fire suppression systems, chemical spill response kits, emergency eyewash stations, safety showers, and automated gas-detection systems at all hazardous process areas.

All occupational injuries, illnesses, near-misses, and unsafe conditions will be reported, recorded in SML's EHS management system, and subjected to root-cause analysis within 48 hours, with CAPAs tracked to verified closure.
DEI (Diversity, Equality and Inclusion): We will promote a diverse and inclusive workforce across all levels of the organization by implementing equitable hiring practices, encouraging diversity in recruitment, and ensuring representation across gender and other relevant dimensions.
We will ensure equal opportunity in all employment practices by maintaining fairness in hiring, promotion, training, and compensation decisions based on merit and competency.
We will foster an inclusive workplace culture that respects diversity by conducting awareness programs, sensitization training, and promoting respectful behavior across all employee groups.
We will prevent and address bias and discrimination in the workplace by implementing structured policies, conducting periodic reviews, and taking corrective actions where gaps are identified.
We will support inclusion of underrepresented and vulnerable groups by enabling accessible workplace infrastructure, inclusive policies, and targeted development initiatives where required.
We will monitor and improve DEI performance across the organization by tracking diversity metrics, reviewing progress at management level, and integrating DEI goals into organizational strategy.
Equal Opportunity & Respectful Workplace: We are an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions including recruitment, placement, compensation, promotion, transfer, disciplinary action, and separation will be based solely on merit, qualifications, demonstrated performance, and legitimate business requirements.

Discrimination on the basis of gender, age, religion, caste, community, nationality, ethnicity, disability, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law is strictly prohibited.

We will ensure a zero-tolerance approach to discrimination and harassment in the workplace by enforcing clear policies, defining unacceptable behaviors, and taking strict disciplinary action against violations.

We will promote an inclusive and respectful workplace culture for all employees by implementing Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI) initiatives and ensuring equal opportunity in hiring, promotion, and compensation practices.

We will provide mandatory awareness and training on prevention of discrimination and harassment by conducting regular training sessions, sensitization programs, and ensuring employee understanding of workplace conduct expectations.

We will maintain a robust and confidential grievance redressal mechanism for discrimination and harassment cases by enabling multiple reporting channels, ensuring timely investigation, and protecting the privacy of all parties involved.
We will ensure protection against retaliation for individuals reporting discrimination or harassment by strictly enforcing non-retaliation policies and monitoring post-reporting workplace conditions.
Pay equity will be assessed annually across genders and equivalent roles. Any identified gap will be documented, root-cause analyzed, and remediated within the same financial year.
Fair Working Conditions & Labor Practice: Provision of lawful, fair, and transparent employment terms including written contracts, statutory wages, full benefit coverage, lawful working hours, and clean and safe facilities for all worker categories.

We will provide a safe, hygienic, and comfortable workplace environment by maintaining proper housekeeping, ventilation, lighting, sanitation facilities, and access to clean drinking water across all operational and office areas.

We will provide adequate welfare facilities to support employee wellbeing by ensuring availability of rest areas, canteen facilities, transportation support (where applicable), and separate amenities for male and female employees.

We will monitor and improve working conditions through regular inspections and audits by conducting internal assessments, engaging employees for feedback, and implementing corrective actions to address identified gaps.

We will ensure full compliance with legal requirements on working hours, overtime, and rest periods by implementing attendance monitoring systems, periodic compliance audits, and ensuring all overtime is voluntary and compensated as per statutory provisions.

All wages will be paid accurately, on time, and through verifiable electronic payment channels, with detailed pay slips provided to every worker reflecting all earnings, deductions, and statutory contributions.

All eligible employees will be enrolled from Day 1 of eligibility in mandatory statutory benefit schemes including EPF, ESI, Gratuity, Paid Leave, Maternity Benefit, and applicable state welfare funds.
We will operate a confidential, accessible, and multi-channel grievance redressal mechanism ensuring every concern is acknowledged within five working days and resolved with full documentation.
Employee Well-being: We will support work-life balance for employees by encouraging reasonable working hours, providing leave benefits, and promoting flexible work arrangements where feasible.

We will address workplace stress and mental health concerns proactively by conducting stress management sessions, awareness programs, and enabling employees to seek support through confidential channels.
We will provide a healthy and supportive workplace environment by ensuring ergonomic workstations, adequate rest breaks, and a positive organizational culture that prioritizes employee wellbeing.
We will encourage employee participation in wellbeing initiatives by organizing engagement activities such as fitness programs, health camps, and wellness challenges across locations.
Career and skill Management & Developmen: Systematic investment in employee skills, technical competency, and career progression through structured training, Individual Development Plans, internal promotions, and leadership development program.

We will ensure continuous skill development of employees across all functions by conducting structured training need assessments and delivering role-based technical, behavioral, and compliance training programs annually.

We will promote internal talent growth and succession planning by identifying high-potential employees, providing leadership development opportunities, and ensuring readiness for critical roles through structured succession plans.

We will enhance employee learning through multiple development platforms by providing access to e-learning modules, on-the-job training, cross-functional exposure, and external certifications where required.

An annual Training Needs Assessment (TNA) process will be maintained for each employee, identifying competency gaps and development aspirations and translating these into Individual Development Plans (IDPs).

Managerial, supervisory, and senior technical vacancies will be assessed for internal candidacy before external recruitment, with merit-based selection processes, transparent communication of outcomes, and active succession planning for critical roles.

We will ensure a structured and fair performance evaluation system for all employees by conducting periodic performance appraisals based on defined KPIs, maintaining transparency in evaluation criteria, and linking performance outcomes with career development and reward mechanisms.
Ethical Labor Practices & Human Rights P: Absolute prohibition of child labor (under 18 years), forced, compulsory, bonded, or debt-bondage labor, and any form of human trafficking across SML's operations, contractor network, and supply chain.

We will enforce ethical labor practices across our supply chain and contractor workforce by integrating labor compliance clauses in contracts, conducting due diligence, and monitoring suppliers and contractors for adherence to human rights standards.

We will conduct periodic audits and inspections to identify and mitigate risks related to child and forced labor by performing internal and third-party assessments and implementing corrective actions for any identified gaps.

We will provide awareness and training to employees, contractors, and suppliers on human rights and ethical labor standards by conducting regular training sessions and communicating expectations clearly across all levels.
Age verification through original, government-issued identity documentation will be mandatory for every worker before commencement of employment.

Any verified instance of child labor, forced labor, or human trafficking in SML's direct operations or contractor workforce will result in immediate cessation of the employment or commercial arrangement, engagement of appropriate authorities.
Employee Engagement & Communication: Structured, open, and non-retaliatory communication between management and workers, including functioning grievance mechanisms, Worker Communication Forums, and POSH Internal Complaints Committees.

We respect and uphold every worker's right to freedom of association and collective bargaining in accordance with applicable Indian law. The Company will not interfere with, penalize, discourage, or obstruct lawful union formation, membership, or representative activity in any form.

We will ensure effective two-way communication between management and employees by conducting regular town hall meetings, team briefings, and structured communication sessions across all levels of the organization.

A structured Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) comprising both management representatives and elected or nominated worker representatives will be established and maintained at each manufacturing site, meeting formally at least once per quarter.
An Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) constituted in full compliance with the POSH Act 2013 will be operational at every SML location employing ten or more persons.
We will enforce a strict, documented non-retaliation policy protecting all employees who raise concerns in good faith through any channel from adverse employment action.

policy.monitoring:
Shilpa Medicare Limited is committed to the continuous improvement of its labor and human rights performance across all manufacturing facilities, R&D centres, and offices.

Safety performance (LTIFR, LTIs, near-misses), wage compliance, working hours, statutory benefit enrolment, training coverage, grievance resolution rates, gender diversity metrics, and contractor audit findings are tracked at each facility on a regular basis.

Periodic internal HR and EHS compliance audits, and third-party labor rights assessments, assess compliance status, identify improvement opportunities, and verify progress against Policy targets.

All occupational incidents, POSH complaints, labor rights violations, wage deviations, and contractor non-compliances are reported, investigated for root cause, and resolved through the CAPA system.

Labor and human rights performance data covering all seven issue areas is reviewed by Senior Management at least quarterly to assess target achievement, risk trends, and Policy effectiveness.

Performance data is compiled and disclosed in the Company's Annual Report and Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report (BRSR) under SEBI LODR Regulations.

Shilpa Medicare Limited has established a structured and transparent process to monitor and report labor and human rights performance across all operations. Key data on safety performance (LTIs, LTIFR, near-misses, PPE compliance), wage and benefit compliance, grievance resolution rates, POSH complaint status, training hours, gender diversity indicators, contractor audit findings, and statutory compliance status are systematically collected, validated, and reviewed on a monthly basis at facility level and quarterly at corporate level.
policy.reviewMechanism: This Ethical Labor & Workforce Rights Policy is reviewed at least once every year by CHRO, or whenever triggered by significant changes in business operations, new or amended applicable labor legislation, changes in regulatory requirements, material changes in manufacturing scale or workforce composition, stakeholder expectations, or the occurrence of a significant labor or human rights incident.
